question: Why is the bias term useful?
direct_answer: It lets the neuron shift its response independently of the inputs.
expanded_answer: The bias changes where the neuron activates. Without a bias, the neuron’s output is constrained to pass through the origin in input space, which can make the model less flexible. The bias gives the network an adjustable offset.
key_points: It adds flexibility to the model
Without bias, decision boundaries can be overly constrained
common_wrong_ideas: Bias changes the slope of every input weight
Bias is only needed in convolution layers
Bias has no effect if the weights are learned
